copilot_proposals_target_valid.name: copilot_proposals_target_valid
copilot_proposals_target_valid.value: ("copilot_proposals"."kind"='update_change_draft' AND "copilot_proposals"."change_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "copilot_proposals"."base_change_version" IS NOT NULL) OR ("copilot_proposals"."kind"<>'update_change_draft' AND "copilot_proposals"."change_request_id" IS NULL AND "copilot_proposals"."base_change_version" IS NULL)

copilot_proposals_state_valid.name: copilot_proposals_state_valid
copilot_proposals_state_valid.value: ("copilot_proposals"."status"='DRAFT' AND "copilot_proposals"."operation_id" IS NULL AND "copilot_proposals"."request_hash" IS NULL AND "copilot_proposals"."result" IS NULL AND "copilot_proposals"."executed_at" IS NULL) OR ("copilot_proposals"."status"='EXECUTED' AND "copilot_proposals"."operation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "copilot_proposals"."request_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "copilot_proposals"."result" IS NOT NULL AND "copilot_proposals"."executed_at" IS NOT NULL)

copilot_proposals_time_valid.name: copilot_proposals_time_valid
copilot_proposals_time_valid.value: isfinite("copilot_proposals"."created_at") AND isfinite("copilot_proposals"."updated_at") AND isfinite("copilot_proposals"."expires_at") AND "copilot_proposals"."updated_at">="copilot_proposals"."created_at" AND "copilot_proposals"."expires_at">"copilot_proposals"."created_at" AND "copilot_proposals"."expires_at"<="copilot_proposals"."created_at"+interval '24 hours' AND ("copilot_proposals"."executed_at" IS NULL OR (isfinite("copilot_proposals"."executed_at") AND "copilot_proposals"."executed_at">="copilot_proposals"."created_at" AND "copilot_proposals"."executed_at"<="copilot_proposals"."expires_at" AND "copilot_proposals"."updated_at">="copilot_proposals"."executed_at"))

api_tokens_expiry_window.name: api_tokens_expiry_window
api_tokens_expiry_window.value: isfinite("api_tokens"."created_at") AND isfinite("api_tokens"."expires_at") AND "api_tokens"."expires_at" - "api_tokens"."created_at" BETWEEN interval '24 hours' AND interval '2160 hours'

change_request_versions_criteria_array.name: change_request_versions_criteria_array
change_request_versions_criteria_array.value: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("change_request_versions"."acceptance_criteria") = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length("change_request_versions"."acceptance_criteria") > 0 AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("change_request_versions"."acceptance_criteria", '$[*] ? (@.type() != "string")') ELSE false END

project_document_chunks_locator_valid.name: project_document_chunks_locator_valid
project_document_chunks_locator_valid.value: "project_document_chunks"."locator_kind" IN ('page', 'paragraph') AND "project_document_chunks"."locator_start" >= 1 AND "project_document_chunks"."locator_end" >= "project_document_chunks"."locator_start" AND "project_document_chunks"."locator_end" <= CASE WHEN "project_document_chunks"."locator_kind" = 'page' THEN 500 ELSE 500000 END

project_document_versions_result_valid.name: project_document_versions_result_valid
project_document_versions_result_valid.value: ("project_document_versions"."status" = 'PROCESSING' AND "project_document_versions"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "project_document_versions"."error_code" IS NULL AND "project_document_versions"."extracted_chars" = 0) OR ("project_document_versions"."status" = 'READY' AND "project_document_versions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "project_document_versions"."parser_version" IS NOT NULL AND "project_document_versions"."error_code" IS NULL AND "project_document_versions"."extracted_chars" > 0) OR ("project_document_versions"."status" = 'FAILED' AND "project_document_versions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "project_document_versions"."error_code" IS NOT NULL AND "project_document_versions"."extracted_chars" = 0)
